# Shortcut Kitchen

> > A recipe blog focused on easy, quick weeknight dinners with an emphasis on air fryer cooking and simple kitchen techniques.

Shortcut Kitchen is a comprehensive recipe resource created by Dani that specializes in fast, accessible recipes featuring air fryer cooking, simple side dishes, and essential kitchen gear. The site contains over 220 pages of recipes designed for busy home cooks seeking healthy, flavorful meals that can be prepared in 15-30 minutes.

## Key Topics

- Air Fryer Cooking
- Quick Weeknight Dinners
- Chicken Recipes
- 15-Minute Meals
- Easy Recipes
- Air Fryer Chicken
- Simple Side Dishes
- Kitchen Gear
- Smoked Paprika
- Parmesan Cheese
- Italian Seasoning
- Quick Meals
- Chicken Drumsticks
- Recipe Collection
- Easy Cooking

## Air Fryer Chicken Recipes

- [Air Fryer Spinach Artichoke Stuffed Chicken](https://daniblogger.com/air-fryer-spinach-artichoke-stuffed-chicken): Air fryer spinach artichoke stuffed chicken recipe with cream cheese and mozzarella
- [Air Fryer Lemon Pepper Chicken Done Right](https://daniblogger.com/air-fryer-lemon-pepper-chicken): 28-minute air fryer lemon pepper chicken with bold citrus flavor and seasonings
- [Crispy Air Fryer Garlic Parmesan Drumsticks](https://daniblogger.com/air-fryer-garlic-parmesan-drumsticks): 35-minute air fryer garlic parmesan drumsticks with panko breadcrumbs
- [Air Fryer Chicken Shawarma: Bold Flavor in 30 Min](https://daniblogger.com/air-fryer-chicken-shawarma): 30-minute air fryer chicken shawarma with Middle Eastern spices and tahini sauce
- [Crispy Air Fryer Chicken Drumsticks](https://daniblogger.com/air-fryer-chicken-drumsticks): 25-minute crispy air fryer chicken drumsticks with smoked paprika spice rub

## Quick Side Dishes

- [Sautéed Cabbage: Simple, Buttery, and Done in 15 Minutes](https://daniblogger.com/sauteed-cabbage): 15-minute sautéed cabbage recipe with butter, olive oil, and smoked paprika
